face_quality_crfiqa_s.description: CR-FIQA(S) face quality scorer (fdbtrs/CR-FIQA, CC BY-NC 4.0) -- catches a misidentified non-face object (tattoo/wallpaper/poster/etc.) or badly-occluded face beating the real subject when building the local performer index. Deliberately under models/quality/, not models/buffalo_l/ -- FaceAnalysis's directory auto-scan misclassifies its 112x112 input as a second recognition model if placed alongside w600k_r50.onnx.

buffalo_l_genderage.description: buffalo_l gender/age classifier (used standalone for a soft cross-gender matching signal, not part of the detection+recognition pipeline)
